seo.homeTitle: Falamor: love declarations with photos, voice and music
seo.homeDescription: Turn your photos into a spoken love declaration with music, ready to send on WhatsApp.
seo.homeImageAlt: Falamor logo with hearts and the text: Say I love you out loud

landing.title: Say I love you out loud
landing.lead: Your photos and words become a spoken memory, ready in minutes, to move the one you love.
landing.step1Text: Trips, birthdays and the silly everyday moments.
landing.step2Text: In your own words or with one of our declarations.
landing.step3Text: They open it on their phone, turn up the sound and feel every word.
